newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Reuters poll of U.S. economic forecasts.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Reuters poll of U.S. economic forecasts.

text.p: Reuters has collected forecasts from economists at 30 banks, securities firms and research institutions on the U.S. economy from the third quarter of 1996 through the third quarter of 1998.
At 1100 EDT/1500 GMT, Reuters will issue analyses and tables of forecasts for eight economic indicators, four foreign exchange rates and five interest rates.
Similar polls are being conducted for other Group of Seven industrial nations.
If you have any questions about this poll, or are interested in taking part, please contact Jeff Coelho at 212-859-1562, or Scott Gerlach at 212-859-1868.
